description: This source file defines a specialized class `YAHOO.widget.RootNode` that extends the generic `YAHOO.widget.Node` to handle the specific case of a root node in a tree view widget. The class manages a virtual root node that lacks presentation, providing a custom constructor and overriding the `getNodeHtml` method to return an empty string.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.RootNode
classes.description: A custom node class for the root of a tree, handling a presentationless root node by overriding methods and constructor behavior.

methods.name: YAHOO.widget.RootNode
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a special root node that handles the virtual root of a tree view, setting the tree reference and altering default node behavior.

methods.name: getNodeHtml()
methods.description: Overridden method to produce no HTML for the root node, reflecting its virtual, presentationless nature.
